question: Which lines of the template audit point at a document that has been read since the audit?
raw:
I can't answer this precisely, because nothing in the audit records shows a document read after the audit ran.

- **Oregon DEQ audit (2026-11-03):** its readings are as of 2026-10-14.
- **Checklist audit of 12-auditor-checklist-deq-air.docx (2026-11-03):** its readings are also as of 2026-10-14.
- **Every reading I hold:** each one is dated 2026-10-14, which is before both audits ran on 2026-11-03.

So no line in either audit points at a document read after the audit. The audits saw every reading I have.

Three things to keep in mind:

Do you know of any document that was replaced or re-uploaded since 2026-10-14? If so, tell me which one. I can then say which audit lines rest on the older reading.
